articles.title: EPL Q2 Results: Profit rises 4% YoY to Rs 111 crore
articles.content: EPL reported a notable 4.52% increase in net profit, reaching Rs 110.9 crore for the September quarter of FY27. With revenues from operations climbing to Rs 1,567.4 crore, a 30% year-on-year growth, the Beauty & Cosmetics and Oral Care segments played pivotal roles. Despite higher expenses, the EBITDA margins held strong above 20%. Looking forward, EPL is set to focus on sustained revenue growth and stable profit margins.

articles.title: India bonds climb in step with Treasuries as oil sinks
articles.content: Indian government bonds increased for the fourth consecutive session following a Democratic win in the US midterm elections. This victory led to a decline in crude oil prices, easing inflation concerns for India. The 10-year US Treasury yield also fell significantly, impacting investors' expectations. A trader noted that upcoming inflation data would be critical for assessing the Reserve Bank of India's rate outlook.

articles.title: Sitaram Denims India files IPO papers with Sebi
articles.content: Sitaram Denims India Ltd plans to launch an initial public offering with two components. The IPO includes a fresh issue of equity shares and an offer for sale by promoters. Proceeds from the fresh issue will be used for various purposes including repayment of borrowings and working capital requirements. The company aims to set up a new garment manufacturing facility in Bhilwara to expand capacity.
